datasets.sql:
SELECT card_main.findfilial (f.filialid) AS filial, t.val_name AS valyuta,
       a.acc_no AS hesab, z.ostat AS hesab_qaliq,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid28), 0) AS dtesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid28), 0) AS dplan,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid28), 0) AS ktesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid28), 0) AS kplan,

      card_main.findmoh28(z.ostat,
      NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid28), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid28), 0),
      NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid28), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid28), 0)) as Verilecek_mebleq


  FROM filialaccounts f,
       ACCOUNT a,
      
       smart.avalute_t t,
       smart.tenostat  z
      
 WHERE f.valid = t.valute
   AND f.accid28 = a.ID
  
   AND f.accid28 = z.acc_id
   
   AND f.filialid <> 0

UNION


SELECT card_main.findfilial (f.filialid) AS filial, t.val_name AS valyuta,

       b.acc_no AS hesab, s.ostat AS hesab_qaliq,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid48), 0) AS dtesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid48), 0) AS dplan,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid48), 0) AS ktesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid48), 0) AS kplan,
    
    card_main.findmoh48(s.ostat,
      NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid48), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid48), 0),
      NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid48), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid48), 0)) as Verilecek_mebleq


  FROM filialaccounts f,
       
       ACCOUNT b,
       smart.avalute_t t,
     
       smart.tenostat  s
 WHERE f.valid = t.valute
  
   AND f.accid48 = b.ID
  
   AND f.accid48 = s.acc_id
   AND f.filialid <> 0
ORDER BY HESAB

datasets.name: payment
datasets.sql:
/* Formatted on 2011/06/02 14:19 (Formatter Plus v4.8.6) */
SELECT p.ID, c.cardnumber, c.rbsnumber rbsnumber_1, c.accid, card_main.getcurr(c.rbsnumber) as currency ,
       p.ammount, p.lammount, p.NAME, 'D' tip,p.dat,sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id)  opid,sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.commit_opid)  commitedopid,(select name from filial_t where id=c.filial) filial,p.tim tim,c.multi_acc  multiacc
  FROM card_clients c, smart.provarch p, smart.ACCOUNT a1, smart.ACCOUNT a2
 WHERE 
    p.dat between :dat1 and :dat2
   and  NVL (p.vid_op, 0) <> 1
   AND c.accid = p.debt
   AND a1.ID = p.debt and c.maincard is null
   AND a2.ID = p.kredit
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT *
                     FROM card_payment_balno bn
                    WHERE bn.kredit = a2.bal_cn1 or bn.debt = a1.bal_cn1)
   AND c.messtype <= 2
   AND NVL (p.vid_op, 0) NOT IN (:vids)
   
   and p.id not in (select PROVID from card_paymentfilter)    
UNION ALL
SELECT p.ID, c.cardnumber, c.rbsnumber rbsnumber_1, c.accid, card_main.getcurr(c.rbsnumber) as currency,
       p.ammount_c ammount, p.lammount, p.NAME, 'C' tip,p.dat,sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id)  opid,sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.commit_opid)  commitedopid,(select name from filial_t where id=c.filial) filial,p.tim tim,c.multi_acc multiacc
  FROM card_clients c, smart.provarch p, smart.ACCOUNT a1, smart.ACCOUNT a2
 WHERE
    p.dat between :dat1 and :dat2
   and NVL (p.vid_op, 0) <> 1
   AND c.accid = p.kredit
   AND a1.ID = p.debt and c.maincard is null
   AND a2.ID = p.kredit
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT *
                     FROM card_payment_balno bn
                    WHERE bn.kredit = a2.bal_cn1 or bn.debt = a1.bal_cn1)
   AND c.messtype <= 2
   AND NVL (p.vid_op, 0) NOT IN (:vids)
   and p.id not in (select PROVID from card_paymentfilter)
